facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay the party 975 gold pieces (three-quarters price for their barrow treasure) once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note for joining the party.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated how much of the note each is owed or when payment is due.
